newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Feb contruction value up in nominal terms.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Feb contruction value up in nominal terms.

text.p: The total value of construction work undertaken by registered firms in Mexico in February rose 18 percent in nominal terms against the same month last year, the National Statistics Institute (INEGI) said on Wednesday.
INEGI released a chart showing the total value of construction was 3.530 billion pesos in February, up from 2.992 billion pesos in February 1996.
The total value of construction was absent from a news release on February construction figures sent by INEGI earlier on Wednesday.
The chart did not reflect the change in total value of construction in real terms.
On March 7, Banco de Mexico reported that year-on-year CPI inflation through the end of February 1997 was 25.64 percent.
